solution_space_constraint_assessment.constraint_basis: Both chains require one shared object and one applied-action relation: the model predicts optimizer-consumed margins; calibration acts on those margins; optimization applies them to coupled gains; rendering returns only the verified policy. Separate model, critic, safety filter, tank or timeout controller recreates an accepted failure. Encoder, set and solver choices remain implementations inside this principle.

candidate_principles.principle: Represent soft contact by the smallest history-conditioned, action-conditional future-margin capacity tube preserving robust impedance decisions; calibrate it on declared shifts; use it inside one incumbent-preserving horizon program whose only rendered output is a verified feasible time-varying normal/tangential impedance policy.
activation_conditions: Held-out/history-dependent contact changes feasible coupled impedance near physical or computation margins.
candidate_principles.intervention: Encode safe history; predict candidate-gain-conditioned force/moment, slip, loss, energy and actuator margins; calibrate their tube; shift/verify the prior policy; improve it in one robust program; commit verified candidates only; return the incumbent at deadline.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Environment identification plus controllers becomes one decision-calibrated capacity-to-feasible-impedance relation.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: Histories are separated by decisions/margins they change; uncertainty, objective, hard limits, fallback and rendering share the same variables/policy.
